name: Neural Marching Cubes
definition: A method that extracts a triangle mesh from a discrete implicit field (scalar values) by using a neural network to predict local mesh topology and vertex positions, allowing for the recovery of sharp features and complex topologies without additional gradient or normal inputs.
summary: Neural Marching Cubes is a data-driven isosurface extraction method that uses a 3D convolutional neural network to predict local mesh topology and vertex positions, preserving sharp features by learning contextual dependencies from neighboring cubes.
